audit.why: Early is hers (dagger bleed + packmates), levels 4-5 tilt to Vladimir's sustain, her 6 briefly retakes it, items end it. TRICKY 7/10 with a 54.1% owner WR over 3816 games is a fair 'hard early, favoured late' read.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart: phases[3] said Naafiri while content/packet say Vladimir; phases[4-6] said Skill while content/packet say Naafiri (L6) then Vladimir. The content layer already matches the packet exactly.
audit.why: Side edits alone plus rewritten whys per the chart rule; no win[N] edits needed.
audit.corrected: phases[3]->Vladimir, phases[4]->Naafiri, phases[5-6]->Vladimir, whys rewritten to match each verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content credited her level-6 shield and dashes to 'The Call' (her W, The Call of the Pack) — the recast shield and pack dash belong to Hounds' Pursuit (R). spikes[0] also named Hounds' Pursuit as her lvl 3-5 gap-closer, but R is not available pre-6; the early dash is Eviscerate (E, 450 range). Plus 14 misgendered fields, 2 bleed bullets, no digit in cooldowns.
audit.why: Kit: W = untargetable pack empower (26-18s), E = 450 dash every 11-7s, R = 900-range pack dash with recast + shield, 110/95/80s.
audit.corrected: Ability attributions fixed, pronouns fixed, real cooldowns inserted, bleed bullets rewritten.

audit.why: missingInteractions asks for anti-heal timing into Eviscerate sustain; report[8] already carries 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' — only the pronoun needed fixing.

edits.before: Naafiri's early all-in is real: her Darkin Daggers plus Hounds' Pursuit gap-close let her burst you down before Transfusion can out-heal it, and her packmate damage makes short trades lopsided in her favour. Keep the wave slightly toward you, use Sanguine Pool to dodge her Q dagger recast and E dash, and never let her stack daggers on you in the open.
edits.after: Naafiri's early all-in is real: her Darkin Daggers plus the Eviscerate dash let her burst you down before Transfusion can out-heal it, and her packmate damage makes short trades lopsided in her favour. Keep the wave slightly toward you, use Sanguine Pool to dodge her Q dagger recast and E dash, and never let her stack daggers on you in the open.

edits.before: Naafiri spikes hard at 6 — The Call gives her extra dashes, damage, and a shield for a committed all-in that can outrace your Hemoplague heal, so this is her window, not yours. Play safe, hold pool for her R engage, and don't duel her when she's ulted unless a gank is coming for you.
edits.after: Naafiri spikes hard at 6 — Hounds' Pursuit dashes her whole pack onto you and its recast adds a shield, a committed all-in that can outrace your Hemoplague heal, so this is her window, not yours. Play safe, hold pool for the R engage, and don't duel her post-ult unless a gank is coming.

edits.before: She keeps the edge through her level-6 spike: The Call's extra dashes and shield fund a dive that outraces your heal, so respect that window and hold Sanguine Pool for her engage rather than dueling into an active ult.
edits.after: She keeps the edge through her level-6 spike: Hounds' Pursuit's dashes and recast shield fund a dive that outraces your heal, so respect that window and hold Sanguine Pool for her engage rather than dueling into her ult.

notes: Kit attribution corrected throughout: the level-6 shield/pack-dash is Hounds' Pursuit (R); The Call of the Pack (W) is the untargetable pack empower and has no shield. wants.you[1] still says 'The Call engage' — W does start her empowered pattern so it is defensible, left alone. Content win[] already matched the packet exactly (Naafiri L1-3 and L6, Vladimir at 4-5 and from first item), so full-layer sides were moved with rewritten whys and no win[N] edits. dosFull[0].d still calls the daggers 'hounds' — cosmetic, left within the not-invented rule.
